free_tier.stated: 'When you sign up for CockroachDB Cloud, your new organization's account starts with $400 in free credits, allowing you to try the product at no cost.' The page states no trial length.

per_object_cap.stated: 10 GiB storage per organization on the recurring allowance; no per-object cap is published

retention.stated: no trial length is stated; billing starts on the day the last credit is used, or on credit expiry, and a 30-day grace period follows if no payment method is added

egress.terms: data transfer leaving the cluster is billed separately and the free-trial and Basic plan pages publish no included transfer allowance and no per-GB rate; recorded as a gap after checking both

record.interface_detail: the Postgres wire protocol with CockroachDB extensions; a Cloud API and the cockroach CLI
record.tooling: psql-compatible clients, the cockroach CLI, the Cloud API
record.chaining: the only free tier above 10 GiB of card-free-capable relational storage, if the card question resolves in your favour

limits.value: USD 400 of credits, with no published expiry

identity_cost.detail: GitHub, Google, Microsoft or an email address and password; a name, company and email verification on the email path; a payment method only at the end of the trial

record.reliability_note: no inactivity power-off; Request Unit consumption scales to zero when the cluster is idle. The trial path ends in an unrecoverable deletion 30 days after the credits run out without a payment method
record.confidence_note: two first-party pages were read on 2026-10-23: the free-trial page for the credits, the grace period and the deletion sentence, and the Basic plan page for scale-to-zero and the storage-limit behaviour. The deletion after the grace period is unrecoverable, which the word 'interruption' would understate.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'your new organization's account starts with $400 in free credits' and 'If the trial ends and a payment method has not been provided, a 30 day grace period begins.'
quoted: Standard '$0.092 per vCPU-hour', footer 'Standard from $0.057 / vCPU-hr' (the page contradicts itself), Mission Critical $0.162

record.notes: The pricing page carries two different Standard rates and prices the product as 'Cockroach Continuum' from 2026-09-15. RAM is never stated. No arbitrary process can be hosted; the credit buys a managed database.
record.binding_note: the request-unit counter throttles and the storage cap refuses writes, but both are recoverable. The 30-day deletion after the trial credits end is not: it removes every cluster in the organization and the page states they cannot be restored.
record.limits_note: the trial length is not published; the record's earlier 30 days is not supported by the page

extras.rate_conflict: the Standard card reads USD 0.092 per vCPU-hour and the footer table reads 'Standard from $0.057 / vCPU-hr' on the same page

history.title: Corrected on 2026-10-23: compute/databricks, compute/digitalocean, compute/linode and 6 more records

card.summary: $15/month of free resource consumption per pay-as-you-go org, equivalent to 50 million Request Units AND 10 GiB of storage per month

free_tier.stated: $15/month of free resource consumption per pay-as-you-go org, equivalent to 50 million Request Units AND 10 GiB of storage per month

retention.stated: 10 GiB storage/month free allowance; 50M RUs/month; 30K RU/sec ceiling on Basic; the legacy 'Serverless free tier' (5 GiB + 50M RUs, no card) has been replaced. Current signup is $400 credit for 30 days then the $15/month Basic allowance.

egress.terms: Not separately charged (storage + RUs are the meters); but the free allowance is denominated in dollars, so ANY overage converts to a bill. Effectively metered.

record.tooling: psql / any Postgres wire client (CockroachDB is PG-wire compatible), `cockroach` CLI, Cloud API
record.chaining: The $15 credit is per ORG, and the 10 GiB is a monthly allowance, not a permanent bucket. New orgs get a separate $400 30-day trial. There is no documented per-account cap on the number of orgs, so 50 orgs x 10 GiB = 500 GB in principle. But each org requires a distinct signup and a payment method to keep the $15 recurring benefit, which is a much higher friction per byte than Telegram or a drive.
record.limits_note: 10 GiB storage/month free allowance; 50M RUs/month; 30K RU/sec ceiling on Basic; the legacy 'Serverless free tier' (5 GiB + 50M RUs, no card) has been replaced. Current signup is $400 credit for 30 days then the $15/month Basic allowance.
record.reliability_note: Very reliable, but the free tier is a dollar credit rather than a hard quota, so a runaway query or a large storage footprint silently converts to charges. Storage is billed on logical GiB with 3 replicas included.

evidence.proved: 'Each pay-as-you-go CockroachDB Cloud organization ... is given $15 of resource consumption (equivalent to 50 million Request Units and 10 GiB of storage) for free each month.'

card.summary: $15/month of free resource consumption per pay-as-you-go org = 50M Request Units + 10 GiB storage/month

free_tier.stated: $15/month of free resource consumption per pay-as-you-go org = 50M Request Units + 10 GiB storage/month

egress.terms: No separate egress charge on Basic. Billing is storage GiB + Request Units. So egress is effectively free within the RU budget, and reads are the meter.

record.tooling: Postgres wire protocol (psql, any driver), `cockroach` CLI, Cloud API; no object storage. Bytes must live in tables/BYTEA.
record.chaining: The $15 credit is per ORGANIZATION and explicitly spendable 'across all CockroachDB Basic clusters in an organization'. It is a monthly consumable, not a standing quota. 10 GiB is the storage-equivalent, and multi-region replication multiplies storage 3-5x against the same credit. New orgs get a $400 trial credit on top.
record.limits_note: 10 GiB/month equivalent; hitting the storage limit blocks writes ('cluster will be unable to write to its storage'); hitting the RU limit disables the cluster until next cycle. Pricing changed for deployments created on/after 2026-09-15 ('Cockroach Continuum').
record.reliability_note: Cluster is DISABLED when RU budget is exhausted. A hard stop mid-month, not throttling. Replication factor 3 eats the storage budget 3x.

evidence.proved: '$15 of resource consumption (equivalent to 50 million Request Units and 10 GiB of storage) for free each month ... can be spent across all CockroachDB Basic clusters in an organization'
'This pricing applies to Cockroach Continuum for anyone getting started or adding new database deployments on or after September 15, 2026'
